assumptions.cost_basis: Supplied total modelled variable cost per sale (the variable costs we choose to model). A teaching assumption — NOT the workbench's technical_premium (a claims-only estimate).
assumptions.demand_basis: Supplied synthetic purchase probabilities — not learned from real customers. A real exercise would estimate and validate them from suitable quote-response data.
assumptions.segment_note: An invented synthetic segment. 'grandma in a BMW' is a mnemonic (age ≥ 70, higher vehicle group); it is not a claim that real older motorists are unresponsive to price.
